name: Irvine Kinley
role: Witness at the de Morès trial
mentions: A Lawyer Jailed by a Judge.

…Judge Francis and some of the members of the bar. A correspondent says: Several witnesses had been examined. Irvine Kinley and Frank Pecket testified to having heard Luffsey and companions threaten De Mores' life. Justice Mark Bateman testified concerning the examination in his court…
